name: SureRank [ALPHA]
author: Brainstorm Force

sections.description:
NOTE: SureRank is currently in the Alpha version and it’s not recommended to use it on live production websites.

SureRank is a WordPress SEO plugin that takes a fresh approach to simplify website optimization for search engines.

Unlike traditional SEO plugins that can feel overwhelming and complex, SureRank is designed to be a personal SEO assistant that guides users through the SEO process with ease.

At its core, SureRank aims to simplify the often-daunting task of SEO by eliminating technical jargon and providing a beginner-friendly interface.

Contributors & Developers

“SureRank [ALPHA]” is open source software. The following people have contributed to this plugin.
Contributors
Brainstorm Force
sections.faq:
Will SureRank slow down my website?

No! SureRank is designed to be lightweight and efficient to ensure it does not impact your website’s performance or load time. We also continuously update the plugin to maintain high performance across different WordPress setups.

What are the requirements to use SureRank?

You only need to have the latest version of WordPress on your website. SureRank is basically a plugin like any other WordPress plugin. Therefore, the latest WordPress installation along with a theme is enough to begin with.
